requirement.value: Dowser (Invoker), Elementalist, Entropist or Symbolist mastery + Invocation

system.description: After an enemy you can see hits or misses you with an offensive spell (), if the Result of their Magic Check was an even number, you may immediately use the Invocation Skill for free (after the spell has been fully resolved) to perform an invocation you have access to against that enemy, without spending Mind Points. This invocation must not be a "hex", and it may target only that enemy (you cannot use the Linked Invocation Skill with it).
